mods.name: Premiumcraft
mods.description: A progression challenge where the vanilla game is the paid tier. Mining, jumping, doors, armour slots, sleeping: 25 everyday verbs start locked. You buy them back with ore, not money. Deposit coal, iron and diamonds at the exchange for credits, then spend them through a three-tier catalogue. Server-side only, so vanilla clients install nothing. No real currency is involved anywhere.

releases.notes:
First release. Minecraft **26.2**, Fabric Loader **0.19.3+**, requires **Fabric API**.

The vanilla game is the paid tier. 27 everyday verbs start locked, from mining and jumping to
opening a door or wearing boots. You buy them back with ore, not money.

**Server-side only.** Your players install nothing, including the store, which renders as an
ordinary chest on unmodified vanilla clients.

- Deposit coal, iron, gold and diamonds for credits
- Three tiers (Survival, Comfort, Luxury) that unlock in order
- Hotbar slots sold individually at an escalating price, locked ones shown as barriers
- Per-player save data for purchases, credits and trial usage
- Difficulty presets: easy, moderate, difficult

Drop the jar in your server's `mods/` folder alongside Fabric API.
